issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for DSTU2 reporting that the vital signs invariant shared with US Core used the wrong component/related logic and could reject component-based examples such as blood pressure by requiring a root value[x] or dataAbsentReason.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly names FHIR-12492. The Jira comment says the expression error was fixed in GitHub; the closest source-history evidence is 1b733457b23ef1115efbd8a72ea094114d279c49, which reworked the legacy vital signs spreadsheet invariant around component, related, value, and dataAbsentReason. Later commits 5bdc6559670c09dbdcbfcdf5f716f84455c6e600 and f9057f0d24 migrated the model from related to hasMember and made the FHIRPath expression use explicit exists() calls.
additional_context: Observation is an active current build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/observation/implementationguide-Observation-vitalsigns.xml includes StructureDefinition/vitalsigns. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant records that conflict with the Jira and source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml has vsp-2 as `(component.empty() and hasMember.empty()) implies (dataAbsentReason.exists() or value.exists())`, which permits observations with components or hasMember references without requiring a root value[x] or dataAbsentReason.
